title: Why everyone is buying Accounting Businesses💰🤓 | M&A Attorney Sara Sharp
description:
If you've recently watch any of the videos floating around the internet talking about buying a business or acquistion, it's no secret that these businesses are selling and can be profitable. But the truth is that the operations side of these businesses are far more complex than is often represented in these videos, which is why everyone I represent is opting to purchase Accounting Practices. In this video you hear the truth from Sara Sharp, a deal attorney that works in Mergers and Acquisitions every single day, about what it's actually like to buy an accounting business. Sara works with business owners every day that are buying and selling accounting practices, and in this video she'll tell you why they're so popular and everyone wants to buy them.
